# 297_R6FIX.30 (BL-115): scripts/live identity-key fetch helper

## Summary

Non-prod identity-shim callers fetched `rhema-<stage>-identity-headers-key` from Secret Manager
by hand. `scripts/live/identity-key.mjs` wraps the `gcloud secrets versions access` read in the
never-argv/log/repo contract: stdout for `VAR="$(…)"` substitution, or `--var NAME -- cmd` env
injection into a child process. `prod` and non-shim stages refuse (the shim is never armed
there); the value never becomes an argv element or a log line. Caller docs (`run-live-exit`,
`res1-probe` → `research-probe-live`) now name the helper.
